shots.focal_element: Group of green workshop frames on a Miro board, then the selection toolbar's 'Create slides' button
shots.transition_other: cold open (first shot, no incoming transition)
on_screen_text: HOW DO WE MAKE IT HAPPEN?
shots.typography: Real product UI text: small sans-serif interface labels; inside the frames, heavy condensed grotesk all-caps headlines (TEAM WORKSHOP, HOW DO WE MAKE IT HAPPEN?) with tight tracking; a dark tooltip with small white sentence-case label
shots.what_happens: A busy Miro board pans slowly while the collaborator cursor 'Billy' drags a marquee around six slide-like frames (about 3.5 s). The camera pushes in on the selection, the board fades to an empty dotted canvas leaving only the floating selection toolbar, Billy hovers the 'Create slides' button (tooltip appears) and clicks; the frames then scatter into a 3D card cloud at about 8.0 s. VO 'Check this out, your presentation in the same space as your work. And boom' (w0-w13).
shots.build_rebuild: Play a screen capture of the board with a slow pan, animate a named cursor drawing a selection rectangle, then scale-in on the selection, fade everything except the toolbar to the canvas background, show a tooltip on hover and trigger a click that bursts the frames into a perspective card cloud.

shots.focal_element: White rounded pill title card with the slides icon and 'MIRO SLIDES' over a drifting cloud of slide cards
shots.transition_other: continuous 3D card-burst from s001 resolving into the title card (no visible cut)
on_screen_text: HOW DO WE MAKE IT HAPPEN?
shots.typography: Product name in heavy bold italic sans-serif, all caps, moderate tracking, black on a white rounded card with soft shadow; background slide cards carry condensed all-caps headlines
shots.what_happens: The six workshop slides float as tilted 3D cards at different depths and drift slowly with parallax while a white title pill reveals 'MIRO SLIDES' (the final 'S' appears to land just after 8.5 s), timed to VO 'enter Miro Slides' (w14-w16).
shots.build_rebuild: Place slide images as 3D-transformed planes at varied z-depths with slight rotation and a slow camera drift, then pop a centered white rounded card with icon and bold italic all-caps product name on top with a soft drop shadow.

shots.focal_element: The 'Team workshop' slide deck frame on the Miro board showing six numbered slides
shots.transition_other: 3D card cloud flies back and settles into a flat slide-deck frame (camera pull-back), then the board UI fades in
on_screen_text: HOW DO WE MAKE IT HAPPEN?
shots.typography: Product UI labels in small sans-serif; slide headlines in condensed heavy all-caps grotesk and bold sentence-case sans; 'How do we get there?' section header in large bold green sans
shots.what_happens: The floating cards collapse into a tidy numbered 'Team workshop' deck frame on the board as the Miro UI fades in. Billy drags a board table (spreadsheet-like widget) from the left into slide 4 and reorders the 'HOW DO WE MAKE IT HAPPEN?' and 'Recap' slides, showing content and context living together. Near the end the view switches to the Slides editor with slide 1 enlarging and a second cursor 'Aaliyah' appearing. VO 'It's your content, your way, all while keeping in the important context that got you there in the first place.' (w17-w36).
shots.build_rebuild: Animate the card planes from the 3D cloud to flat grid positions inside a frame, fade in the board chrome, then script a named cursor dragging a table into a slide and swapping two slide cards with a short slide-and-settle ease.

shots.composition_other: product editor layout: slide thumbnail rail left, large slide canvas center, presenter notes below
shots.focal_element: Slide 1 'TEAM WORKSHOP' in the Miro Slides editor, later the slide deck as a 3D stack
shots.transition_other: UI morph from board view into the Slides editor (slide scales up to editor canvas)
on_screen_text: Let's get more daily app visits
shots.typography: Slide title in very large condensed heavy grotesk all caps with tight tracking (changes from dark green to black during the shot); subtitle in medium-weight geometric sans sentence case with an emoji; UI chrome in small sans-serif
shots.what_happens: In the Slides editor, Aaliyah and Billy cursors co-edit slide 1: a People panel opens to show collaborators, the title colour is changed live, and Billy moves toward 'Present'. From about 20.8 s the editor chrome falls away and the deck fans out into a tilted 3D stack of slides that rotates toward camera, landing on slide 1. VO 'Create slides with your team, build together,' (w37-w43).
shots.build_rebuild: Show the editor capture with two named cursors and a popover panel, then hide the UI and transform the slide images into a staggered 3D stack (rotateY with z offsets) that rotates flat to frame slide 1.

shots.focal_element: Full-screen presentation of slide 1 with live audience avatars and reactions
on_screen_text: Let's get more daily app visits
shots.typography: Slide title in very large black condensed heavy grotesk all caps, tight tracking; subtitle in medium geometric sans sentence case; small sans-serif in the presenter toolbar
shots.what_happens: Presentation mode fills the frame: participant avatar bubbles float over the slide, emoji reactions (fire, party popper) pop in, and a presenter toolbar ('Frame 1/6', 'Stop') slides up from the bottom. VO 'and run smooth,' (w44-w46).
shots.build_rebuild: Zoom the slide to full frame, then pop circular avatar bubbles and emoji reaction stickers in with a quick scale-overshoot and slide a rounded presenter toolbar up from the bottom edge.
